class Base {
  m() { return 1; }
  get value() { return 3; }
  static get shared() { return 4; }
}
class Delayed extends Base {
  static { console.log(super.shared); }
  constructor(callback: () => number = () => super.m()) {
    const get = () => super.value;
    super();
    console.log(callback(), get());
  }
}
class Initialized extends Base {
  constructor(flag: boolean) {
    if (flag) super();
    else super();
    console.log(super.m(), super["value"]);
  }
}
class Unreachable extends Base {
  constructor() {
    throw Error("stop");
    console.log(super.m());
    super();
  }
}
new Delayed();
new Initialized(false);
try { new Unreachable(); } catch { console.log("stopped"); }
